facts.fact: TheCable reports a circular dated 27 July 2026 directing all federal MDAs to comply with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, as the law governing their processing.
The document names Vincent Olatunji as national commissioner of the NDPC and Babatunde Bamigboye as its head of legal, enforcement and regulations.
The NDPC national commissioner said the commission had established a regulatory clinic giving technical support to MDAs; MDAs are also to notify the NDPC of their DPOs for registration.
